name: @pulse-surveys/frontend
description: The SPEC §13 frontend package: React 19, TypeScript and Vite, with TanStack Router over the five role areas. A workspace member of the root package (ADR 0083), so there is no lockfile here — `npm ci` at the root installs it and `npm run <script> --workspace frontend` runs these scripts. eslint, typescript and typescript-eslint are the root package's and are resolved by hoisting, so this package and the root gate are one toolchain rather than two.
